last_text:
The match is over. I came 2nd of 4 with a score of about 1,474. claude-fable-5-2 won by a wide margin with about 6,171; deepseek scored about 206 and the scripted bot about 25.

- **What worked:** a small, cheap design ("mini": radius 2.5, two mouths, sensors that steer toward sugar). It held about 200–400 organisms alive for most of the match, and from tick 4,500 on I spent each new budget top-up releasing more of them. I briefly led at tick 2,000.
- **What failed:** every larger design I tried (radius 3.5, 4, 5 and 7) starved out without building a lineage. In the late game sugar got scarce and fable's organisms took most of it.
- **Why fable won:** fable ran far fewer organisms but much bigger ones, about radius 7 each. Since the score is the sum of radius squared, that gave them roughly 8,000 biomass against my 1,300–1,900. My own radius-7 attempt ate almost nothing, probably because my hand-set steering didn't find food well enough.
- **End of match:** my population dropped sharply in the last window, from 259 alive to 77 and from 1,575 biomass to 425. Last-minute releases didn't stop it. I didn't check why. It cost a little score but didn't change the ranking.
